definitions.explanation: Done without any particular intention or deep thought. Often describes words or actions that have an unintended impact.

examples.japanese: {何気|なにげ}ない⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧。
{何気|なにげ}ない⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
⟦{何気|なにげ}なく→何気なく：19263_nanigenaku⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つけて→傷つける：01935_kizutsukeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Words I said without thinking ended up hurting the other person.
examples.notes: The adverbial form {何気|なにげ}なく is very common.

notes:
FORMS:
- Adnominal: {何気|なにげ}ない + noun
- Adverbial: {何気|なにげ}なく
- Predicate: {何気|なにげ}ない (rarely used predicatively)

USAGE:
Most commonly used as a modifier before a noun ({何気|なにげ}ない⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧, {何気|なにげ}ない⟦{仕草|しぐさ}→仕草：10917_shigusa⟧) or in the adverbial form {何気|なにげ}なく. Often implies that a casual or unthinking action had significant consequences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何気|なにげ}ない⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧: an offhand remark
- {何気|なにげ}ない⟦{仕草|しぐさ}→仕草：10917_shigusa⟧: an unconscious gesture
- {何気|なにげ}ない⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧: ordinary daily life
- {何気|なにげ}なく⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to glance casually

WATCH OUT:
{何気|なにげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is widely used in casual speech as an adverb meaning "casually" or "actually," but it is considered nonstandard. The standard adverbial form is {何気|なにげ}なく.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {何気|なにげ}なくなかったら
